timeline.text: The kiosk screen could only show one number — never whether it was climbing or falling.
That limit was built into the system — the display was walled off from history entirely.
I found the wall inside the API and moved it — kiosk screens could finally look backward.
Every reading from the last day now shows up as a trend, not a snapshot.
One dot became a full day: the kiosk now sees 24 hours of history.
